issues.quote: Total assets stood at $624.9 million at the end of fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Wrong unit. Amazon's total assets at year-end 2024 were about $624.9 billion, not million.

data.summary: Most of the figures match Amazon's FY2024 results: revenue of $638.0B, up 11% from $574.8B; net income of $59.2B; operating income of $68.6B; and cash and cash equivalents of $78.8B. The one error is total assets, which are stated in millions when they should be in billions ($624.9B). The note to record it as $624.9B is correct.
